title: Run reference (CONTRACT.md 4.3)
description: A run's identity, the same wherever it appears: progress _meta (`table-manners/run`), the result's run (with `dir`), runs-list entries and a reuse refusal. The root is closed; the other schemas extend $defs/run_ref and close it themselves.

session_id.description: The serving session; null for a run made outside one (a tool's CLI).

client_run_id.description: The caller's correlation id; null when the request sent none.

session_id.description: A random UUID (v4), lowercase, generated when the server starts.
